hints: Focus on how $\text{NO}$ and $\text{NO}_2$ are linked, they quickly interconvert in air rather than acting alone.
Remember that brown $\text{NO}_2$ absorbs sunlight to start smog, but it is made from colourless $\text{NO}$ from car engines.
Consider what happens when both gases are further oxidised in moist air, they both end up as nitric acid in rain.
walkthrough:
**Start where NOx comes from**

Think of a hot car engine. Nitrogen and oxygen from air combine at high temperature to make colourless $\text{NO}$ first.

$$\text{N}_2 + \text{O}_2 \rightarrow 2\text{NO}$$

**See why both gases make photochemical smog**

In air, $\text{NO}$ is oxidised to $\text{NO}_2$. Then sunlight splits $\text{NO}_2$ to give oxygen atoms that make ozone, the main part of smog.

$$2\text{NO} + \text{O}_2 \rightarrow 2\text{NO}_2$$
$$\text{NO}_2 + \text{sunlight} \rightarrow \text{NO} + \text{O}$$
So $\text{NO}$ is the starter and $\text{NO}_2$ is the sunlight absorber. Both are essential.

**See why both gases make acid rain**

Both $\text{NO}$ and $\text{NO}_2$ are eventually oxidised in moist air to nitric acid, $\text{HNO}_3$, which falls as acid rain.

$$4\text{NO}_2 + 2\text{H}_2\text{O} + \text{O}_2 \rightarrow 4\text{HNO}_3$$
Since $\text{NO}$ turns into $\text{NO}_2$ so easily, $\text{NO}$ counts as an acid rain source too. That gives ticks in all four boxes.

options.A: Correct. Both $\text{NO}$ and $\text{NO}_2$ are involved in both processes. $\text{NO}$ from combustion oxidises to $\text{NO}_2$, $\text{NO}_2$ drives ozone formation in smog, and both lead to $\text{HNO}_3$ in acid rain.
options.B: Incorrect. This says only $\text{NO}_2$ matters. It forgets that colourless $\text{NO}$ is the primary pollutant that makes $\text{NO}_2$ and then ozone and acid.
options.C: Incorrect. This correctly includes both gases for smog but excludes $\text{NO}$ from acid rain. Students choosing this forget $\text{NO}$ is readily oxidised to $\text{NO}_2$ and then to nitric acid.
options.D: Incorrect. This correctly includes both gases for acid rain but excludes $\text{NO}$ from smog. It misses that smog starts with $\text{NO}$ being converted to $\text{NO}_2$ and cycling back.
